answer: Sealed challenge draw. Each identity must submit a fresh random nonce that is bound to a public atlas of pending challenges, then solve a randomly assigned micro-task whose answer depends on that nonce and expires in one round. Answers cannot be copied between identities because each nonce yields a different target, and a hollow replay is rejected outright. A gale of parallel registrations forces the attacker to run a distinct solve per identity, paying full compute and latency each time instead of reusing one answer.
